prs.title: fix(suspense): release parent dep on suspensible unmount
prs.author: maxymlyskov
prs.body:
If a nested `` is removed while it and its parent are both still pending, the parent stays on its fallback forever. Nothing is logged. Repro: an outer `` holding some other content and a `` with a slow async child. Set `show = false` before anything resolves. The outer boundary never leaves its fallback. A suspensible boundary created inside a pending parent takes a dep on it (`parentSuspense.deps++`): packages/runtime-core/src/components/Suspense.ts#L509-L513 and only gives it back in its own `resolve()`: packages/runtime-core/src/components/Suspense.ts#L652-L663 `unmount()` never does, and once the boundary is unmounted its async child returns early when it settles, so `resolve()` never runs and the parent's `deps` never gets back to 0. With the global build in jsdom, 1 s after `show = false`: ```text vue@3.5.44
loading
this branch
other
``` `unmount()` now releases the dep in a post-flush callback, skipped if the parent's `pendingId` has changed or the parent was unmounted. It's deferred for the same reason as #13456: a component that swaps the nested boundary for an async one in the same update would otherwise resolve the parent before the new dep registers (2nd test). 3 tests in `Suspense.spec.ts`, next to the nested suspensible ones. prs.title: fix(hydration): only update component el when replacing its host node
prs.author: ondrhn
prs.body:
A nested node mismatch during SSR hydration can redirect a component's `vnode.el` into its own subtree. A later dynamic component replacement then throws `NotFoundError`, or inserts content after following siblings when wrapped in `Suspense`.

Only synchronize the component and HOC host elements when `parentComponent.vnode.el === node`: the component must still reference the DOM node being replaced. This preserves the component's host element for nested mismatches and also covers a root `Suspense` that is still pending, so switching components before its async dependencies resolve does not use a detached host node.

Regression tests cover nested mismatches with and without `Suspense`, plus a mismatched pending Suspense root: its `$el` points to the replacement, switching components before resolution succeeds, and late resolution of the discarded branch leaves the new page intact.

Validation:
- Runtime-core, runtime-dom, and server-renderer unit tests: 1,779 passed, 1 skipped, including all 146 hydration tests.
- TypeScript check.
- ESLint and Prettier checks on the changed files.

Fixes #16000

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **Bug Fixes**
  * Fixed hydration of server-rendered pages so nested element mismatches no longer disrupt dynamic component replacement or move component refs away from their original root.
  * Switching components now preserves the replacement page and following content when the previous component is still waiting on an async dependency inside `Suspense`.

prs.title: fix(suspense): do not mount the fallback after the boundary is unmounted
prs.author: zhoubiao188
prs.body:
### What does this PR do? Stops a stale `Suspense` fallback from being mounted after the boundary has already been unmounted. ```vue ``` If the boundary is unmounted while the branch is still pending (route change, `v-if` toggle), the `timeout` timer keeps running and later calls `fallback()`: - `patch(null, latestFallback, container, ...)` re-inserts the fallback into a container that no longer belongs to the suspense, so stale content shows up behind whatever replaced the boundary; - `unmount(activeBranch, ...)` runs a second time, so `onBeforeUnmount` / `onUnmounted` of the already unmounted branch fire twice (cleanup / reporting runs twice). The deferred `mountFallback` (installed as `afterLeave` for `out-in` fallbacks) has the same problem. ### Root cause `SuspenseBoundary.isUnmounted` is set synchronously in `unmount()`, and `resolve()` already refuses to run on an unmounted boundary in dev. `fallback()` and `mountFallback()` were missing the same check, so they happily patched into the (now foreign) container. ### Test Added a case to `packages/runtime-core/__tests__/components/Suspense.spec.ts`: mount a boundary with `timeout: 20`, switch to an async branch, unmount the boundary, then wait for the timer. Without the fix: ``` AssertionError: expected '
gone
fallback
' to be '
gone
' ``` `onBeforeUnmount` / `onUnmounted` were also ea …(truncated)

prs.title: perf(compiler-ssr): render static style attributes at compile time
prs.author: danielroe
prs.body:
I was profiling what was taking time on rendering SSR for nuxt, and noticed in the fixture I was using that a plain `style="color: red"` attribute got rendered at runtime on every request because it becomes a constant _dynamic_ binding and we then compile that to be rendered with `ssrRenderStyle`

this PR instead renders static `style` attributes on plain elements directly into the open tag at compile time, which significantly speeds up rendering static styles...

| what | before | after | delta |
| - | - | - | - |
| 100 static sections, 400 inline styles | 150.2 µs | 3.6 µs | -98% |
| same inside `v-for`, with an interpolation | 132.0 µs | 6.4 µs | -95% |

prs.title: fix(suspense): keep the async root update retry across a discarded pending branch
prs.author: edison1105
prs.body:
## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **Bug Fixes**
  * Updated content is now reflected when switching between views that contain unresolved async components.
  * Discarded pending views no longer trigger stale updates after their async components resolve.
  * Fixed a hydration scenario where a newer async branch could fail to display while an earlier branch and a sibling were still pending. The latest branch now appears once it resolves.

  * Improved how nested Suspense content updates while a parent is loading, including retained content and nested route changes.

prs.title: fix(runtime-core): render nothing for a component whose async setup rejects
prs.author: edison1105
prs.body:
## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **Bug Fixes**
  * Components whose asynchronous setup fails now render an empty placeholder instead of falling back to their template or triggering additional render errors.
  * During server rendering and hydration, failed components preserve the expected placeholder markup, and the configured error handler receives the setup error without duplicate follow-up errors.
  * Suspense boundaries now handle rejected async setup consistently, including components that provide a render function, while retaining the fallback and rendering placeholders for failed components.

prs.title: fix(KeepAlive): cache a resolved Suspense child right away
prs.author: edison1105
prs.body:
## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **Bug Fixes**
  * Improved component reuse when switching between views wrapped in `KeepAlive` and `Suspense`. Returning to a previously displayed view now preserves its state without rerunning setup.
  * Components still unmount when their `KeepAlive` wrapper is removed, and caching remains correct while a Suspense view is loading.
  * Route rendering checks now wait for updates to settle, helping ensure the displayed view is verified after navigation.
